== Categories ==

Hi. Thanks for joining us here and thanks for your recent edits. I wanted to let you know about our character template. Not only does it display the table at the top-right of the page, but it also adds the page to different categories based on several of the parameters in the template. See [[:Template:Character|here]] for a breakdown on it. Please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks again and welcome! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 06:55, February 23, 2013 (UTC)
